title: LEGB 作用域链：Local->Enclosing->Global->Builtin
expected_output:
local reads: enclosing-x
enclosing reads: enclosing-x
global reads: global-x
builtin max: 7
code:
x = "global-x"

def enclosing():
    x = "enclosing-x"
    def local():
        # 未重新绑定 x，按 LEGB 向上找到 enclosing-x
        print("local reads:", x)
    local()
    print("enclosing reads:", x)

enclosing()
print("global reads:", x)

def use_builtin():
    # 'max' 不在局部/闭包/全局，回退到 builtin 命名空间
    print("builtin max:", max(3, 7, 2))
use_builtin()
